description: This file defines the AnalysisRepository class, which encapsulates CRUD operations related to the 'analyses' table in the database. It includes methods for creating a new analysis, retrieving an analysis by ID, updating the analysis status and score, and listing analyses by user.

classes.name: AnalysisRepository
classes.description: A repository class providing database operations for analyses, inheriting from BaseRepository.

methods.name: UUID create( self, user_id: int, resume_id: Optional[int], profile_id: Optional[int], target_role: Optional[str], status: str, score_overall: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronously inserts a new analysis record into the database and returns its UUID.

methods.name: Optional[dict] get(self, analysis_id: UUID)
methods.description: Fetches an analysis record by its UUID, returning a dictionary or None.

methods.name: None update_status(self, analysis_id: UUID, status: str, score_overall: Optional[float] = None)
methods.description: Updates the status and optionally the score of an analysis identified by UUID.

methods.name: List[dict] list_by_user(self, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of analyses for a specific user, ordered by creation date descending.
